name: card-field
title: Card Field
description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups by brand, then slides away to its last four digits to make room for expiry and security code.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol shown before the amount.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Called with brand, last4 and MM/YY when Pay is pressed. Return a promise and the button waits for it; reject to decline.

props.name: testMode
props.description: Shows a 'Use test card' link that types a test number in for you.
